dimensions.name: Audience Journey Completeness
dimensions.pass_criteria: The documentation covers the primary user's complete journey from first access through core use to any required go-live or production steps.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more major stages of the user's journey are missing or too thin to be actionable.

dimensions.name: Technical Internal Consistency
dimensions.pass_criteria: Any term, field name, endpoint, setting, or concept that appears in multiple documentation files uses identical naming throughout.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more terms, field names, or concepts are named differently across files.

dimensions.name: Format Fit for Product Type
dimensions.pass_criteria: The documentation format matches the product type: developer portal docs for APIs, task-oriented guides for user apps, setup and operations guides for admin/ops tools.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The documentation format is mismatched to the product or feels like a generic template.

dimensions.name: Product Specificity
dimensions.pass_criteria: The documentation is written specifically for this product. Product name, capabilities, persona, and workflows from the Press Release are reflected.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The documentation is generic or could apply to any product of its type.

dimensions.name: Press Release and FAQ Grounding
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every capability documented traces to the Press Release or FAQ. Open items that affect documentation are explicitly marked [TBD - pre-launch].
dimensions.fail_criteria: The docs describe capabilities not established in the PR or FAQ, contradict the PR, or silently resolve Internal FAQ open items.
